issues: src/lib/ledger.ts does not export the required functions and types: appendEntryForReceipt, appendEntryForMileage, computeHash, LedgerEntry, getLedger, setLedger. The file only defines appendEntryForExport and references undefined identifiers (Store, getLedger, setLedger, computeHash), causing TS2724 and TS2552 errors.
src/lib/ledgerHelpers.ts imports computeHash from './ledger' and calls getLedger/setLedger, but computeHash and those helper functions are not exported from ledger.ts, leading to TS2305 errors.
src/lib/ledgerVerification.ts imports computeHash from './ledger' and uses getLedger from './ledgerHelpers', but computeHash is missing, causing TS2305 errors.

src/lib/receiptStore.ts does not import or invoke any ledger functions after adding, editing, or deleting a receipt. Consequently, ledger entries for receipt.created, receipt.corrected, and receipt.deleted are never created (missing R5‑R7).
src/lib/mileageStore.ts (not shown) similarly lacks calls to ledger functions for mileage.created, mileage.corrected, mileage.deleted (missing R8‑R10).
src/screens/ReceiptHistoryScreen.tsx and src/screens/MileageHistoryScreen.tsx import LedgerEntry from '../lib/ledger', but LedgerEntry is not exported, causing TS2305 errors.
src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx does not call verifyLedger or render a VerificationStatus component, so Settings does not display "Verified • N entries • intact" or warning messages (missing R24‑R25).

The ledger initialization (imported entries on first launch) in src/lib/ledgerHelpers.ts attempts to compute hashes using computeHash, which does not exist, so imported entries are never correctly created (missing R11‑R12).
Hash chain logic (prevHash linking, first entry prevHash of 64 zeros, canonical JSON hash calculation per R15‑R17) is not implemented because computeHash is absent.

Export verification (CSV/PDF line format, verificationCode calculation, export.created ledger entry) is not implemented; appendEntryForExport uses incorrect fields and does not follow the spec (missing R26‑R28).
Backup/restore does not verify the ledger before applying data; restoreBackup does not invoke verifyLedger, nor does it abort on failure or handle legacy backups (missing R35‑R39).

UI flow test fails at the "Save receipt" button because the receipt store does not call the ledger functions, causing a TypeError when the test attempts to call appendEntryForReceipt (issue observed in __tests__/acceptance/m8.test.ts).
feedback: The ledger core is missing entirely: required types and functions are not defined or exported, resulting in compile errors and runtime TypeErrors. Consequently, all ledger-related requirements (creation, correction, deletion entries; hash chaining; import on first launch; verification; export linking; backup verification) are unimplemented. UI components that depend on ledger data also fail to compile. Implement the LedgerEntry type, computeHash (canonical JSON + SHA-256), appendEntryForReceipt, appendEntryForMileage, getLedger, setLedger, and ensure receiptStore/mileageStore invoke these after each operation. Add proper hash chain handling, import logic, export verification, backup verification, and UI integration in Settings and History screens. After fixing these, re-run tests and ensure UI flow passes.
